label: Structural completion rate
formula: completed required placements / eligible required placements

label: First-response accuracy
formula: correct first valid responses / eligible scored first responses
missing_data_policy: missing if no eligible response; no imputation by default

label: Final-response accuracy
formula: correct final valid responses / eligible scored final responses

label: Scheduled review completion
formula: completed scheduled reviews / eligible scheduled reviews
missing_data_policy: report deferrals and unavailable periods separately

label: Active interaction time
formula: sum(capped active intervals under declared idle rule)
missing_data_policy: never infer unobserved activity; sensitivity analysis

label: Hint use
formula: hint-requested eligible occurrences / eligible practice occurrences

label: Artifact revision count
missing_data_policy: exclude nominal renames if policy states

label: Consent coverage
formula: participants with active required consent / participants requiring consent

label: Condition fidelity deviations
formula: count verified deviations from locked condition

label: Research storage burden
formula: stored authorized research bytes / active participants
